# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed girl who possesses a great deal of beauty. Her attractive looks make a strong impression on others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c15 P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Mabel is a dark-eyed girl who possesses a great deal of charm and beauty. Despite her attractive appearance, she has a heart filled with yearning dreams and imaginative ideas.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c15 P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v1 c22 P9](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0009)_

## Traits

- Dreamy and imaginative  <sub>[v1 c22 P9](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0009)</sub>
- Striking and attractive  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c15 P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby attended Brierley school, where she shared enjoyable times playing with Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and the other female students during lunchtime. On one occasion, she shared her fruit by giving an apple to Nell. Later, as part of her schooling, she joined the same small, close-knit circle of companions as Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c22 P9](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Attended school with Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, where she was considered one of the nice girls  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- Became part of a small group of companions at school alongside Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis  <sub>[v1 c22 P9](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0009)</sub>

## Affiliations

- Brierley School — Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
